name: Task_1
description:
Heat silicon to 2500K using molecular dynamics simulations with LAMMPS. Start from a crystalline silicon structure, which is replicated three times in each direction. The Stillinger-Weber (SW) potential should be used to describe interatomic interactions. Perform the heating under zero external isotropic pressure control using NPT ensemble. Heat the system from 300K to 2500K at a rate of 2.2 K/ps.

Use the conventional eight-atom mp-149 cell, and the supplied potential. Initialize velocities once at 300 K with a recorded seed, choose suitable integration and thermostat/barostat settings, and preserve the atoms, cell evolution, velocities, and elapsed time. Stop at the end of heating and retain the final state. The system may remain crystalline or become liquid; melting is not required at this level.
